claim_tested: NspC pocket constrains carboxyspermidine vs carboxynorspermidine
key_finding: Q88IS0 matches 9/10 norspermidine contacts and 12/14 PLP contacts of C. jejuni CANSDC; only Met276->Tyr273 differs. LysA/ODC controls match 2-3/10.
context: C. jejuni CANSDC crystal structure, 1.9 A, norspermidine + PLP; positions transferred by NW/BLOSUM62
limitations: Homology transfer, no KT2440 structure or model validated here; contacts from one crystal form; Bacteroides K41 column is an alignment gap

claim_tested: A CANSDC-annotated enzyme makes spermidine in vivo
key_finding: Deletion in C. jejuni shows the carboxynorspermidine decarboxylase orthologue synthesizes spermidine, not sym-norspermidine, in vivo; CASDH/CASDC orthologues cluster with putrescine biosynthetic genes
context: Campylobacter jejuni gene deletion, polyamine quantification

citation: KEGG ppu ortholog query; UniProt Pfam query (this work)
claim_tested: KT2440 lacks the canonical spermidine route and any 1,3-diaminopropane source
key_finding: K01611 (speD), K00797 (speE) and K13745 (DABA decarboxylase) return empty for ppu; K13747 returns PP_2929. Zero PF02675 proteins in KT2440 with P. aeruginosa and E. coli positive controls returned. Sole PF01564 protein PP_1867 lacks PF17284.
limitations: Absence of an ortholog call is not proof of absence of activity; a non-orthologous DAP source cannot be excluded

citation: NCBI AE015451; STRING v12; GEO GSE322955 (this work)
claim_tested: PP_2928 is the partner dehydrogenase of nspC
key_finding: 32 bp intergenic gap, same strand; STRING combined 0.972 (neighbourhood 0.818, cooccurrence 0.775); co-expression r=0.981, p=9.6e-16, PP_2928 ranked 1 of 5561; partial r=0.923 after removing the growth-rate axis
context: KT2440 genome, 22 RNA-seq samples across 11 conditions
limitations: Operon inferred from spacing and co-expression, not from a mapped transcript or 5' RACE

claim_tested: PP_2928 substrate-determining positions differ from Bacteroides and Campylobacter enzymes
key_finding: Against the agmatine-bound S. pneumoniae dehydrogenase, C. jejuni and H. pylori match all 13 pocket positions and B. fragilis matches all 11 resolved, while PP_2928 differs at four (Pro86->Ala91, Asn108->Ile113, Tyr109->His114, Glu251->Asp241) plus a gap opposite Phe136
context: 1.19 A NADPH + agmatine complex, released 2026-11-18, no associated publication
limitations: Unpublished structure; the ligand is agmatine, not putrescine or 1,3-diaminopropane; PP_2928 identity to the reference is only 42.8%, so some differences reflect distance rather than specificity

claim_tested: A condition induces nspC and reveals its physiological role
key_finding: No condition induces nspC. Largest changes vs M9 glucose are decreases: H2O2 -1.79, no trace elements -1.60, DPD iron chelation -1.42, NaCl -1.27. nspC correlates with 53 ribosomal protein genes at r=0.888 (98.8th percentile genome-wide).
context: KT2440, 11 conditions x 2 replicates, plus 10 carbon sources
limitations: Two replicates per condition; no polyamine measurement accompanies the transcriptomes; growth-rate coupling is correlative

claim_tested: Spermidine is physiologically used by KT2440
key_finding: Spermidine protects P. putida KT2440 against hydrogen peroxide; agmatine and spermidine increase pyoverdine production
context: P. putida KT2440 arginine biosynthesis mutants, exogenous polyamine addition
limitations: Exogenous polyamine addition; does not establish the biosynthetic route or measure endogenous norspermidine
